chunks: Ali ibn Ahmad al-Bandaneeji narrated to us, from Ubaydillah ibn Musa al-Alawi, from Muhammad ibn Musa, from Ahmad ibn Abu Ahmad al-Warraq, from Ya'qub ibn al-Sarraj, who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah: 'When will the deliverance of your Shia come?' He said: 'When the sons of Abbas disagree and their rule weakens, and those who never hoped for it will seek it, and the Arabs will throw off their yoke, and every person of authority will raise their authority, and the Sufyani will appear, and the Yamani will come, and the Hasani will move, then the Master of this Command will emerge from Medina (or Mecca) with the heritage of the Messenger of Allah.' I said: 'What is the heritage of the Messenger of Allah?' He said: 'His sword, his armor, his turban, his cloak, his banner, his staff, his horse, his saddle, and his saddlebags.'

key_terms.السُّفْيَانِيُّ: The Sufyani, a key figure in Shia eschatology who rises before the Mahdi
key_terms.الْحَسَنِيُّ: The Hasani, referring to a leader from the progeny of Hasan ibn Ali
key_terms.الْيَمَانِيُّ: The Yamani, a leader who calls people to truth before the Mahdi's appearance
key_terms.تَرَاثُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: The heritage of the Prophet, referring to his personal relics and items
key_terms.صَاحِبُ الْأَمْرِ: The Master of the Command, a title for the Mahdi

ai.seo_question: What are the signs of the Mahdi's appearance according to Shia eschatology?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Nu'mani’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* situates the Mahdi’s emergence within a specific eschatological timeline marked by the decline of Abbasid authority and the convergence of three key figures: the Sufyani, the Yamani, and the Hasani. It highlights the concept of 'Prophetic Heritage' (turath), identifying tangible relics like the Prophet’s sword and cloak as symbols of legitimate authority transferred to the Imam, a theme central to Twelver Shia political theology.

en.abdullah-al-shahin: (42) Ali bin Ahmad al-Bandaneeji narrated from Obaydillah bin Musa al-Alawi from Ahmad bin Abu Ahmad al-Warraq that Ya’qoob bin as-Sarraj had said:

I asked Abu Abdullah as-Sadiq (as): “When will the deliverance of your Shia come?” He said: “When the Abbasids disagree, their rule will become weak, those, who have never thought of the rule, will seize the opportunity to gain their (the Abbasids’) rule, the Arabs will become uncontrolled, as-Sufyani will rise, al-Yamani will come with his army, al-Hasani will move with his troops and then al-Qa’im will appear in Medina and move towards Mecca with the heritage of the Prophet (S).” I said: “What is the heritage of the Prophet (S)?” He said: “The heritage of the Prophet (S) is his sword, armor, turban, garment, banner, stick, horse and saddle.”
